and yet... as I am now...

"...I feel pathetic.
It's practically the same as... having doubted your trust in me..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
Those words fire me up more than anything else...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't look down anymore.
Because you are here with me,
all I have to do... is move forward."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...You still... haven't given up
on someone like me, have you...?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
......
Then, I must look ahead.
I must keep running.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Your feelings...
I will never let them go to waste. Never.
